name: Newton
schedule: First Tuesday, 10am, Newton County Courthouse, Covington
note: The county website puts a captcha on every file, so lists can't be read automatically. Use the county link for the October 6, 2026 list.

auction.venue: Newton County Administration Building, First Floor, Room 103-A (location is named in each sale notice)
auction.time: First Tuesday of months with a planned sale, 10:00 am (legal hours 10:00 am to 4:00 pm); registration from 9:30 am
auction.registration: Register in person before the sale with acceptable government-issued identification; registration begins at 9:30 am on sale morning at the sale location. Bidders or a representative must be present to bid.
auction.payment: Certified funds only: cash, cashier's check or money order. The website says payment is due in full by 3:00 pm on sale day; the sale notice says payment may be required within two hours after the sale.
auction.office_address: 1113 Usher St NE, Suite 101, Covington, GA 30014
vital: Opening bid is the tax due plus penalties and all other applicable fees.
The owner or any interested party may redeem within 12 months of the sale; the redemption price includes the bid plus a 20% premium.
After 12 months the buyer may foreclose the right to redeem.
The venue has changed between sales (September 2025 was held at a different site), so check the current notice.
The current list runs in the Covington News legals for four weeks and is posted on the tax sale listing page.
auction.confirmed: October 6, 2026 sale list posted (notice file dated 10.1.2026)
